title: smart-routing-fallback-incident-breadcrumbs-ethan-park-v2
content:
One-line summary: notes + breadcrumbs from investigating regional failover + fallback policy flips on 2026-02-24 -> intermittent 503s and fallback evaluation errors. Working scratchpad for follow-ups; rough and messy.

Context:
- Customer traffic hitting hosted-api via smart-routing layer.
- Incident window: 2026-02-24 09:40 - 2026-02-24 11:20 UTC (reports uptick in errors around 09:40).
- Symptom: elevated 5xxs from hosted API; in-route logs show fallback evaluation failures and 'no compatible model variants' for a subset of requests. Some requests instead returned 503 upstream.

Timeline / breadcrumbs:
- 2026-02-24 09:38 UTC: first alert (SRE pager) - 5xx rate spike in us-east1 -> detected by per-region p50/p95 dashboards.
- 09:40: Slack thread created (#infra-incident). Shared initial query + sample trace ids.
- 09:43: Rolled canary traffic away from us-east1 -> partial improvement but errors persisted for some customers pinned to us-east1.
- 09:50: Observed fallback policy flips in router logs: policy-engine returned FAIL for variant-compat check.
- 10:10: Confirmed capacity did not exhaust Dedicated pools; metrics show GPU utilization ~70% in us-east1 but queue lengths increased for specific model families.
- 10:40: Applied temporary workaround: force-route requests to us-west1 for affected customers (manual routing override). Errors dropped.
- 11:05: Investigated root cause hypotheses; started reproducer locally against staging.

Commands run / snippets captured (kept in chronological order):
- Check public API errors (curl sample):
  curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}' "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?model=rw-v1&region=us-east1"
  -> HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
     Server: redwood-gateway
     x-request-id: rwd-req-0a1b2c3d
     {"error":"upstream_error: region_unavailable"}

- Query router logs (k8s):
  kubectl -n redwood logs deploy/router --since=2h | egrep 'fallback|policy-eval|region' -n | tail -50
  -> entries: 2026-02-24T09:49:12Z router-0 [WARN] fallback-policy: evaluation failed for request=rw-req-0a1b: reason="no compatible model variants found" context={seq_len:1024, quant:8bit}
  -> entries: 2026-02-24T09:49:13Z router-0 [ERROR] smart-routing: region-check failed for model=rw-v1 variant=q8_0 reason="incompatible-kernel: rust-kernel-mismatch"

- Inspect policy config (kubectl get cm fallback-config -o yaml):
  fallback-config:
    policies:
      - name: regional-failover
        allowed_variants: ["q4_0", "q8_0"]
        kernel_compat_map: {"rw-v1": ["rust-kernel-1", "cudnn-8"]}
  -> note: config shows allowed q8_0 but runtime logs complaining about rust-kernel-mismatch for q8_0 in us-east1.

- Check node labels + available kernels in us-east1 pool:
  kubectl -n infra get nodes -l region=us-east1 -o wide
  kubectl -n infra exec -it node/serving-node-12 -- ls /opt/kernels || true
  -> kernels present: cudnn-8, cublas-2, rust-kernel-0 (NOTE: rust-kernel-1 missing on this node).

- Quick grep in model-onboarding service logs:
  kubectl -n models logs deploy/model-onboard --since=24h | egrep 'rw-v1|kernel'
  -> 2026-02-23T03:14:00Z onboarding [INFO] model rw-v1 registered with kernels: rust-kernel-1, cudnn-8
  -> 2026-02-24T01:02:00Z node-sync [WARN] node=serving-node-12 missing kernel rust-kernel-1

- Route-policy service health endpoints:
  curl -sS http://route-policy-internal:8080/health | jq .
  -> {"status":"ok", "lastSync":"2026-02-24T08:55:12Z"}

- Redis cache for variant mapping:
  redis-cli -h redis-main GET routing:variant-cache:rw-v1:us-east1
  -> "{"selected_variant":"q8_0","kernel_req":"rust-kernel-1"}"

- Sample failing request trace (trace id rwd-req-0a1b2c3d):
  router: matched policy regional-failover -> attempted variant q8_0 -> model server connect attempt failed with ECONNREFUSED to 10.45.22.19:9000 -> fallback evaluation attempted but rejected because kernel mismatch on node pool -> request returned 503 upstream.

Observed error messages (copied raw-ish):
- "fallback-policy: evaluation failed: no compatible model variants found"
- "smart-routing: incompatible-kernel: rust-kernel-mismatch"
- "upstream_error: region_unavailable"
- "connect ECONNREFUSED 10.45.22.19:9000"
- "context deadline exceeded (Client.Timeout exceeded while awaiting headers)"

Hypotheses (ranked):
1) Kernel drift across node pool in us-east1: onboarding said rust-kernel-1 required but several nodes missing it. Policy allows q8_0 but runtime rejects because kernel isn't present on serving node. Leads to no compatible variant.
2) Partial node-level outage (serving-node-12) causing connection refused to some model servers and increasing queueing for remaining nodes -> router sees both connectivity and compatibility failures.
3) Race in policy sync vs node-sync: route-policy returning stale variant-cache that references kernel rust-kernel-1; node-sync later marks nodes missing kernel -> mismatch in state leading to rejection.
4) Misconfigured allowed_variants matrix in fallback-config that doesn't include a known-good variant (q4_0) for certain workloads -> reduces fallback options.
5) Unrelated networking flakiness causing ECONNREFUSED but also spurious compatibility log due to shared error handling path.

Evidence for hypothesis 1:
- model-onboarding logs and node-sync warn about rust-kernel-1 missing on serving-node-12.
- ls /opt/kernels showed rust-kernel-1 absent on some nodes.
- router logs explicitly mention rust-kernel-mismatch.

Evidence for hypothesis 2:
- Connect refused to specific ip 10.45.22.19:9000 (node appeared in k8s list but might have restarted).
- GPU utilization not at 100% but queue lengths increased for rw-v1 family.

Immediate actions taken:
- 09:55: Pinned heavy customers to us-west1 (manual override) to reduce error surface.
- 10:15: Triggered node-sync job to re-run kernel installation for missing nodes (job id: node-sync-7745).
- 10:25: Added temporary policy tweak: include q4_0 as fallback for rw-v1 in fallback-config -> applied to route-policy configmap and rolled restart of route-policy.
- 10:40: Observed error rate drop after policy tweak + node-sync completing on 2/3 nodes.

Follow-ups / action items: (assignments tentative)
- (Ethan) Confirm all serving nodes in us-east1 have rust-kernel-1 present OR update allowed_variants to exclude kernel-1 if we cannot install. Due 2026-02-26.
- (Marcus) Add observability: per-node kernel-availability metric exported and an alert when mismatch with onboarding registry. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra-monitoring/pull/62.
- (Olivia) Investigate why node-sync missed installing rust-kernel-1 on serving-node-12 (logs: node-sync-7745). Check permissions, disk space.
- (Oncall) Create runbook blurb for regional-failover explaining kernel compatibility as a failure mode.

Notes for postmortem:
- Root cause likely combination: kernel drift + partial node outage -> reduced fallback capacity and policy rejection.
- Contributing factor: insufficient observability for kernel presence across pool; route-policy accepted variant but didn't validate node pool capabilities atomically. Need stronger pre-flight checks.

Reproducer steps (staging):
1) Spin up staging pool with mismatch: onboard model rw-v1 with declared kernel rust-kernel-1 but leave one or more nodes without that kernel.
2) Send traffic pinned to staging region A; watch router evaluation logs and ensure fallback-policy rejects when serving nodes lacking kernel.
3) Test policy change that adds q4_0 and confirm immediate improvement.

Scratch todo (short):
- Add metric: routing.variant_rejected_reason (tags: region, model, reason).
- Bake a route-policy preflight that queries node inventory before returning variant selection (atomic check).
- Update onboarding -> node-sync contract: on model registration, require X nodes with each kernel (threshold).
- Postmortem write-up draft (start after final RCA). Link to JIRA INF-2026.

Random notes / crumbs:
- Could be useful to add a fallback priority ordering based on kernel-availability score rather than static allowed_variants.
- Check PR-418 in route-policy repo - it was an older attempt to validate kernels but might not have landed in prod.

End of scratchpad. Will keep updating this file as I iterate.
